name: Secherit Site Health Monitor
author: Secherit

sections.description:
Secherit Site Health Monitor helps you identify problems on important WordPress pages from a single dashboard. Check whether pages respond, find broken internal links and verify that forms and buttons are present in the returned HTML.

Free features

  • Manual checks for up to three selected pages on your own website.
  • HTTP response status and response timing.
  • Internal link checks (up to 60 per scan) and guidance for investigating issues.
  • Passive detection of rendered forms and buttons.
  • Check history and CSV export.

Optional Premium add-on

A separate Premium add-on offers scheduled monitoring, additional monitored pages, error monitoring and email reports. Visual comparisons require a separately configured browser worker. The free plugin does not require a Secherit account or license key.

The Plans & license page and read-only interface examples explain the separate add-on. Example controls do not run Premium checks or save Premium settings.

Learn more at Secherit.

Privacy

Manual checks request configured public pages and internal links on your own site. Monitoring history is stored in your WordPress database. Free does not send license requests or tracking data to Secherit. Monitoring history and settings are retained when the plugin is removed.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for Secherit Site Health Monitor, install it and activate it.
  3. Open Site Health Monitor in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Open Settings and choose the pages you want to check on your own website.
  5. Save your settings and select Run checks.
  6. Review the results in the dashboard and export check history from Reports when needed.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use the free plugin?

No. You can run the free checks without a Secherit account or license key.

How many pages can I check?

The free plugin checks up to three configured pages on your own website.

Does the plugin submit contact forms or click buttons?

No. Passive checks detect forms and buttons in server-rendered HTML. They do not submit forms or prove that a form submission or button interaction works.

Does response timing measure full browser loading speed?

No. The HTTP response timing is a diagnostic measurement, not a full browser performance test.

Where are my check results stored?

Check history is stored in your WordPress database. You can export it as CSV from Reports.

Can I run checks automatically?

The free plugin provides manual checks. Scheduled monitoring is part of the separate Premium add-on.
sections.changelog:
1.4.1

  • Added a compact, time-limited Black Week notice for Free users.
  • Address Plugin Check findings in the first-scan form.
  • Suggest monitoring pages and start the first scan directly from Overview.
  • Prevent overlapping scans with a database-backed expiring lock.
  • Keep a bounded per-page link inventory for fairer rotation and remove stale active links only after verified discovery.
  • Mark form and button results unverified when page HTML cannot be inspected.
  • Restrict monitoring to supported public URLs and safely resolve internal redirects and plain permalinks.
  • Exclude removed monitoring targets and unavailable Premium checks from current status; preserve historical records.
  • Clear all scheduled hooks on deactivation, including jobs with arguments.
  • Improve debug status detection and CSV export safety.
  • Show the latest recorded status per check separately from historical scan results.
  • Preserve historical failures and original timestamps; a matching successful recheck clears the active issue.
  • Rotate internal link scan batches to improve coverage.
  • Add a read-only Smart Fix Premium preview under Protection. No repair engine is included in Free.

1.4.0

  • Redesigned the admin navigation with six main sections and grouped tabs.
  • Kept Plans & license accessible to all users, with a clear Free and Premium comparison.
  • Improved the layout of read-only Premium feature previews. Premium functionality remains in a separate add-on.
  • Enforced the three-page Free limit when saving settings and running checks, while maintaining compatibility with licensed Premium monitoring.
  • Increased the number of internal links checked per scan from 12 to up to 60.
  • Improved scan history storage recovery, database error reporting and scan failure feedback.
  • Improved CSV export escaping and database query handling.
  • Updated the health score calculation to display no score when no pass or issue results are available.
  • Preserved monitoring history and settings on plugin removal to support reinstalls.
  • Improved responsive admin styling and asset cache versioning.

1.3.9

  • Omit the optional Plugin URI to resolve the submission validator error.
